class.name: AIStimulusHistory2D
class.brief_description: Bounded, source-aware, time-limited memory for confirmed 2D AI perception events.
class.description: Stores events that the game already considers audible, visible, or caused by real combat. Every event has a sense, optional source ID, 2D position, strength, and lifetime. No world queries or automatic detections occur here. The caller must enforce safe zones, visibility, occlusion, factions, and authoritative target selection before recording. Events are kept oldest to newest. For nonnegative source IDs, a repeated event of the same sense refreshes the existing entry rather than accumulating duplicates. Anonymous source ID -1 keeps independent events. When the maximum capacity is reached, the oldest event is discarded. Expired events are removed by [method advance_time]. [method get_best] ranks live events of one sense by [code]strength * remaining_seconds / ttl_seconds[/code], preferring a lower source ID and then a lexicographically lower position when scores match. This is a memory-priority score, not measured loudness, and it never implies that a player is currently visible. The source identity and coordinates are server-sensitive: do not replicate debug snapshots to ordinary clients.

method.name: set_capacity
method.description: Set a per-instance capacity between 1 and 64. Shrinking discards the oldest entries first.

method.name: record_stimulus
method.description: Record one already-authorized event. Requires finite position, strength in (0, 1], lifetime in (0, 60], and source ID -1 or nonnegative. Returns false without mutation for invalid inputs. Repeated known-source events replace the previous matching-sense event.

method.name: advance_time
method.description: Decrements remaining lifetimes using nonnegative finite elapsed seconds, removing expired records.

method.name: get_event_count
method.description: Returns the number of active records.

method.name: get_best
method.description: Return a detached Dictionary for the highest-scored active event in the requested sense, or an empty Dictionary. Fields: [code]sense[/code], [code]source_id[/code], [code]position[/code], [code]strength[/code], [code]ttl_seconds[/code], [code]remaining_seconds[/code], [code]age_seconds[/code], [code]score[/code].

method.name: get_ranked
method.description: Returns at most [param limit] active, already-confirmed stimuli of the requested sense, ordered by decayed strength (highest first). Ties use the lowest source ID, then X/Y position, independently of arrival order. Limits must be 0–64; invalid senses and limits return an empty Array. Each result is a detached Dictionary with the same fields as [method get_best]. This method does not detect a new target, revalidate a source, or reveal live client positions.

method.name: get_recent
method.description: Returns up to [param limit] detached event Dictionaries newest first. Valid limit is 0 to 64. Intended for server diagnostics and decision-making; no shared mutable state is exposed.

method.name: reset
method.description: Clears all events, preserving the configured capacity.

members.member: Maximum number of simultaneously remembered events (1 to 64).

constants.constant: An authoritative combat stimulus, supplied explicitly by the game.
